formal_statement: ∃ p : Polynomial ℕ, ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : Finset (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause (Fin n))), (∀ C ∈ F, C.card ≤ 3) → ¬ PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Satisfiable (↑F : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause (Fin n))) → ∃ π : List (PEqualNP.Search.LinClause n), PEqualNP.Search.IsResLinRefutation (↑F : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause (Fin n))) π ∧ π.length ≤ p.eval n
plain_statement: Some polynomial p bounds, for every unsatisfiable 3-CNF on n variables, the number of lines of a Res(lin) refutation over F2. Necessary for CDCL over parities (candidate 3) to run in polynomial time on unsat input. Open; a refutation would be a new result: no superpolynomial lower bound for DAG Res(lin) on any 3-CNF is known (only tree-like, regular and bounded-depth fragments).
title: Candidate 3 premise: unsatisfiable 3-CNFs have polynomial-size Res(lin) refutations
